notes: Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe turn borders now follow the shared active side on both phones: player 1/X neon orange, player 2/heart neon chartreuse green, independent of avatar or viewer. Both the outer board and playable small boards switch colors. Compact play view enlarges the board and adds Show/Hide controls, keeping Music in the menu. Both manual dice remain visible for 2.5 seconds before the result, followed by a winner announcement. The spinning side star is pink with a gentle pulsing glow. Winning symbols remain without glow and retain their opposite slow bounces. Tic-Tac-Toe now starts the bundled soundtrack when no queue is chosen, including synchronized room playback. Fixes the room Add-to-Play acknowledgement race. Adds SoundCloud sign-in with saved cookies. No room-server deployment; existing games stay intact.
